title: Quick-create Agent
reasoningUnavailable: This model declares no reasoning levels; the service settings apply
modelsUnavailable: Add a model to this provider first
defaultsHelp: Default model, Agent preset and permissions apply to new sessions. The preset must exist in the deployed Harness
credentialHelp: Enter an environment variable name only; supply its secret value at deployment
permissionHelp: read-only allows reading; workspace-write allows workspace edits; danger-full-access allows full access without approval
routesHelp: allowedModels lists the models sub-agents may select. Enabling selection requires at least one provider/model pair
providersHelp: Add a custom model service using its endpoint, protocol and model IDs, including compatible Volcengine and BytePlus services
coverage: Covers common native settings. Other plugin parameters and preset files are not included yet

providerPlaceholders.displayName: Optional; defaults to the provider ID

errors.positive: Enter a number greater than zero
errors.env: Use letters, digits and underscores; do not start with a digit
errors.url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials
errors.duplicate: This ID or model pair already exists
errors.providerId: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens; reserved IDs are unavailable
errors.routes: Add at least one complete provider/model pair
errors.modelPair: Enter a model ID for this custom provider
errors.unknownModel: Enter a model ID configured for this provider
errors.timer: Enter a timeout greater than 0 and no more than 2147483647 ms
